population.description: Healthy adults already consuming adequate complete protein

gradeRationale.note: A negative claim, deliberately recorded with the same rigour as a positive one. This is the record that lets the engine say 'no' with a citation rather than by omission.

statement: Branched-chain amino acids alone are an incomplete amino acid profile and cannot maximally stimulate muscle protein synthesis without the other essential amino acids that complete protein already supplies; where total protein intake is adequate, BCAA supplementation shows no consistent additional benefit.

citations.title: Branched-chain amino acids and muscle protein synthesis in humans: myth or reality?
